zh.title: Geely EX5 英国发布
zh.summary: Geely EX5 英国发布：展陈、人员联络与发布现场影像。
zh.preview: EX5 是 Geely Auto 在英国推出的首款车型。本案参与围绕发布现场的展陈、人员联络与摄影展开。
zh.role: 项目团队参与人员联络、展陈配合及现场摄影，将现场协作与发布内容记录连接起来。
zh.context: Geely Auto 于 2025 年在英国推出纯电 SUV EX5，作为该品牌进入英国市场的首款车型。这场发布的背景是新车型与品牌在英国的正式亮相。

narrativeSections.heading: 展陈与现场协作
narrativeSections.text: 汽车发布需要让产品在现场得到呈现。本案中的展陈配合与人员联络服务于这一具体任务，摄影则记录发布与车辆亮相。

narrativeSections.heading: 记录产品进入现场的时刻
narrativeSections.text: 交付包括展陈和人员配合，以及发布现场与车辆亮相影像。案例体现汽车发布中将现场支持与内容记录结合的能力。

deliverables: 现场人员联络与展陈配合
outcomes: 项目团队的交付包括现场人员与展陈配合，以及发布和车辆亮相影像。
zh.publicEventOutcome: Geely Auto 在英国正式推出 EX5 纯电 SUV。

en.title: Geely EX5 UK Launch
en.summary: On-site liaison, display support and photography for the Geely EX5 UK launch.
en.preview: The EX5 was Geely Auto’s first model introduced in the UK. This assignment focused on the launch setting through display support, people liaison and photography.
en.role: The project team contributed to people liaison, display support and on-site photography, connecting practical event support with documentation of the launch.
en.context: Geely Auto introduced the all-electric EX5 SUV in the UK in 2025 as its first model in the market. The event sat within the brand’s formal UK introduction and the launch of the vehicle.

narrativeSections.heading: Supporting the product presentation
narrativeSections.text: The launch brought the vehicle into a physical event setting. Display support and people liaison served that practical task, while photography documented the presentation and vehicle reveal.

narrativeSections.heading: A launch record alongside event support
narrativeSections.text: The delivery combined display and personnel support with launch and vehicle imagery. It demonstrates the ability to pair practical support at an automotive event with content production.

deliverables: On-site people liaison and display support
outcomes: The project team’s delivery comprised people liaison, display support and imagery of the launch and vehicle reveal.
en.publicEventOutcome: Geely Auto formally introduced the all-electric EX5 SUV in the UK.
